title: Store service (StoreKit 2 purchases)
summary: The purchase engine: StoreKit 2 StoreService, the Debug FakeStore, the RevenueCat observer, the .storekit file.
description: StoreService is the real store of every Release build (prices only from StoreKit's displayPrice; never finishes a transaction whose grant failed to save). FakeStore serves tests and captures; RevenueCatObserver only observes (no backend of ours); the product table is GameCore's ShopCatalog (core, rules.json `shop`); Attribution's PurchaseReporting is the hook for an optional per-game ad-attribution SDK (off).
notes: IAP catalogue == rules.json shop == .storekit: python3 apps/<slug>/tools/release/meta.py iap-check.
